_comment: THE abandon-combat proof (ratified escape hatch: pause opens mid-fight from the HOTBAR resting mode with the reduced row set, Abandon returns to the last autosave). Route: post_tutorial Continue -> a real inn round-trip FIRST (two map_changed autosaves, so the `auto` slot holds floodplains (7,6) -- without this the isolated QA HOME has no auto slot and Abandon would fall through to game_reset, which is the fallback, not the path under test) -> combat_move_input's exact fight entry (goblin_encounter_2 parley -> Draw steel) -> on the PC's turn: Esc opens pause (ui_pause_shown), cursor down 1 = 'Abandon to Last Save' (COMBAT_ROWS index 1), confirm -> No/Yes panel (cursor starts No, one down = Yes), confirm -> game_loaded back at the autosave. combat_resolved must NEVER fire (abandon tears the UI down and loads; it does not resolve the fight -- assert_event_absent below is the teeth). GH#377: this script is also the scrim's windowed eye. It now opens the FIELD pause and its Load slot picker on the way to the fight (00_pause_over_field / 00b_slot_picker_over_field) before the existing mid-combat pair (01_pause_over_combat, the worst case, and 02_abandon_confirm) -- one shot per pause root, all four in one run. The scrim itself emits no event by design; these four PNGs are its gate.
seed_comment: Seed 9 with the post_tutorial fixture (combat_move_input's pairing). The fight itself is never played out, so its rng draws are irrelevant to this script's assertions.

steps._comment: Down to Continue, confirm loads the post_tutorial manual slot.

== SEED THE AUTO SLOT: the bump up sets facing onto floodplains_inn_door (7,5), interact transitions -> inn (14,3) (autosave rides map_changed), then face east onto inn_door (15,3) and interact back out -> floodplains (7,6) (second autosave, THE position Abandon must restore).

== GH#377 SCRIM READ, FIELD HALF ==. The pause dimmer is ONE full-rect node covering all three pause roots, so all three want an eye on them and only the field pause can reach the slot picker (COMBAT_ROWS carries no Save/Load row). Esc here opens the full ROWS menu over the floodplains; two downs land on 'Load' (ROWS index 2), whose picker is browse-only until a row is confirmed -- Esc backs out of it without touching a slot, then Esc again closes pause. Nothing in this detour spends an action or moves the player, so the fight-entry route below starts from the same (7,6) it always did.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: == FIGHT ENTRY (combat_move_input's exact route): right 21 along the y6 lane, down 11, interact into goblin_encounter_2's parley, 'Draw steel.'
== THE ESCAPE: Esc from the HOTBAR resting mode opens pause (reduced COMBAT_ROWS).
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: Cursor 0 = Resume; one down = 'Abandon to Last Save' (COMBAT_ROWS index 1).
No/Yes confirm panel, cursor starts on No -- one down flips to Yes.
Abandon = teardown + load the auto slot. ui_combat_hidden fires from the teardown, game_loaded from the load.
The teeth: abandoning never RESOLVES the fight -- no outcome, no victory/defeat accounting, anywhere in the run.
